culture.en: China's Ice City — Where Russian Romance Meets Winter Wonder. Ice and Snow World, Saint Sophia Cathedral, Central Street & Dongbei cuisine.
culture.zh: 中国冰城 — 俄式浪漫与冰雪奇缘。冰雪大世界、圣索菲亚大教堂、中央大街与东北美食。

climate.en: Severe cold continental climate. Winter -20°C to -30°C — best for the Ice & Snow Festival (Jan). Summers are cool (20-25°C).
climate.zh: 严寒大陆性气候。冬季 -20°C 至 -30°C，最适合冰雪节（1月）。夏季凉爽（20-25°C）。

transit.en: Metro lines 1-3 plus buses; Taiping Airport 40km from center.
transit.zh: 地铁1-3号线加公交；太平机场距市中心40公里。

intercity.en: High-speed rail from Beijing (~5h), Shenyang (~1.5h), Changchun.
intercity.zh: 北京高铁约5小时、沈阳约1.5小时、长春可达。

tips.en: Dress in layers and bring hand warmers for Ice World; book Ice Festival tickets online in advance.
tips.zh: 分层穿衣，冰雪大世界备暖宝宝；冰雪节门票提前网购。
